meta.name: hunt-ssrf
meta.description: Hunting skill for ssrf vulnerabilities. Built from 15 public bug bounty reports including AWS metadata SSRF (HackerOne $25k Analytics PDF, Shopify Exchange $25k, Capital One 106M-record breach, Dropbox/HelloSign $4,913), GCP metadata SSRF (Snapchat $4k), Azure IMDS SSRF (Azure DevOps $15k chain, ChatGPT Custom Actions MSRC), DNS rebinding SSRF (Concrete CMS, GitLab UrlBlocker), gopher-protocol-to-Redis-RCE (Yahoo Mail $15k), link-preview SSRF (Reddit Matrix $6k), and headless-browser PDF-generator SSRF chains. Use when hunting SSRF on any target — OOB Collaborator confirmation mandatory for blind cases.

copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit server-side request forgery vulnerabilities

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你系统性地测试目标网站是否存在 SSRF 漏洞。它会指导你设置外部监听器、发送测试请求、检查回调，并尝试访问云元数据或内部服务。
howto.when: 当你需要测试某个网站或 API 是否存在 SSRF 漏洞时触发。尤其适合目标运行在云平台（AWS、GCP、Azure）或内部网络复杂的情况。

say.text: 帮我测试这个链接预览功能是否有 SSRF 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会指导你设置监听器并发送测试请求。

say.text: 检查这个 API 端点是否允许访问 AWS 元数据。
say.note: Claude 会提供针对 AWS 元数据服务的测试方法。

say.text: 这个文件导入功能可能触发 SSRF，帮我验证。
say.note: Claude 会建议使用外部回调确认盲 SSRF。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you systematically test target websites for SSRF vulnerabilities. It guides you to set up an out-of-band listener, send test requests, check callbacks, and attempt to access cloud metadata or internal services.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test a website or API for SSRF vulnerabilities. Especially suitable when the target runs on cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) or has a complex internal network.

say_en.text: Help me test this link preview feature for SSRF.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to set up a listener and send test requests.

say_en.text: Check if this API endpoint allows access to AWS metadata.
say_en.note: Claude will provide testing methods for AWS metadata service.

say_en.text: This file import feature might trigger SSRF, help me verify.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using external callbacks to confirm blind SSRF.
